events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_full $6.61 (model confidence 0.90)
events.body:
The driver cancelled this RydeX trip, so NS-0 routes the case to NS-1/NS-2 [F4][NS-0]. Under NS-1 the no-show fee requires all three elements. Element (i) is met — the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 21:29:10 [F6][NS-1]. Element (ii) is met — at the moment of the tap he was 42 m from the pickup, i.e. within the arrival radius [F6][NS-1]. Element (iii) fails: he was continuously inside the 200 m radius for only 105 seconds (1 min 45 s) after the tap before cancelling [F6][NS-1], and his total cumulative time within 200 m before cancellation was 2 min 50 s, never exceeding the required 3 min 1 s [F2][NS-1]. His own chat message at 21:30 saying "waited too long" comes only minutes after arrival [F10][F4], and his post-trip statement of a 5-minute wait is a statement contradicted by the GPS and timeline records, which prevail [F12][F2][F4].

Because NS-1(iii) is not satisfied, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee is refundable in full to the rider [F7][NS-2]. The NS-2 account flag does not attach because the driver's tap was genuine — he was 42 m from the pickup when he tapped, so there is no fake "I'm Here" [F6][F1][NS-2]. The profile facts (rider clean at 0/0; driver with 2 upheld no-show disputes) cannot decide the case and, since no refund-producing route-deviation ground exists here, RD-6 is not engaged [F16][F17][RD-6]. Amount: the fee on record is $6.61 [F7][F4][NS-2].

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: We reviewed your cancellation fee dispute. You're getting the $6.61 fee back in full as a Ryde voucher. Your driver cancelled the trip, but he hadn't waited long enough at the pickup for a no-show fee to apply — he arrived and cancelled only about two minutes later. His later claim of a five-minute wait doesn't match the trip records, so we went with the records. Nothing is needed from you; the voucher will be applied to your account.

DRIVER: We reviewed the cancellation on your RydeX trip. The $6.61 no-show fee is being refunded to the rider as a voucher, because you cancelled before completing the required waiting time at the pickup — you were there for under two minutes, not the full three minutes the fee requires. We've noted the early cancellation on your record; no account flag was added, since your "I'm Here" tap was genuine and you were at the pickup point. Please give riders the full wait next time.
